summary: SLM Student Loan Trust 2006-7 filed an 8-K (Items 8.01/9.01) with an Event Notice disclosing an affiliate of depositor Navient Funding, LLC intends to submit a Hold Order in the October 14, 2026 auction for the $27,750,000 Class A-6B Notes it already holds in full, and to submit buy bids on October 16, 2026 for all unheld Class A-6C Notes ($27,700,000 held of $27,750,000 outstanding) at 30-day Average SOFR + 0.11448% + 1.50% per annum. No board recommendation, advisor, price per share or deal date beyond auction dates is stated. These are routine auction-rate securities remarketing mechanics, not a special situation; watch for failed auctions and rate resets.
